before.requirement: When allocation of the document URL base fails during XInclude processing, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
before.reason: On this path, the old helper sets ctxt->errNo to XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY, matching the harness check.

after.requirement: When allocation of the document URL base fails during XInclude processing, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
after.reason: The new helper does not write ctxt->errNo. The allocator behavior needed to establish a feasible input-triggered failure, and the effects of xmlRaiseMemoryError, are not supplied.

claims.reason: The same root-base allocation-failure condition is assessed on both sides. The old helper records the checked code; the new helper delegates error reporting, whose effects and feasible trigger remain unresolved.

source_evidence.quote:
struct _xmlXIncludeCtxt {
    xmlDocPtr             doc; /* the source document */
    int                 incNr; /* number of includes */
    int                incMax; /* size of includes tab */
    xmlXIncludeRefPtr *incTab; /* array of included references */

    int                 txtNr; /* number of unparsed documents */
    int                txtMax; /* size of unparsed documents tab */
    xmlXIncludeTxt    *txtTab; /* array of unparsed documents */

    int                 urlNr; /* number of documents stacked */
    int                urlMax; /* size of document stack */
    xmlXIncludeDoc    *urlTab; /* document stack */

    int              nbErrors; /* the number of errors detected */
    int              fatalErr; /* abort processing */
    int                 errNo; /* error code */
    int                legacy; /* using XINCLUDE_OLD_NS */
    int            parseFlags; /* the flags used for parsing XML documents */
    xmlChar *		 base; /* the current xml:base */

    void            *_private; /* application data */

#ifdef FUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION
    unsigned long    incTotal; /* total number of processed inclusions */
#endif
    int			depth; /* recursion depth */
    int		     isStream; /* streaming mode */

    xmlXPathContextPtr xpctxt;
};
